name: photosphere-monorepo
description: This monorepo contains the backend and frontend for [the Photosphere application](https://rapidfullstackdevelopment.com/example-application).

scripts.compile: bun --filter '*' compile && what-changed baseline capture compile
scripts.test: bun --filter '*' test && what-changed baseline capture test
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:cli && bun run test:cli:encrypted && bun run test:cli:lan-share && bun run test:electron
scripts.dev: bun run bundle:renderer && bun run --filter=photosphere dev
scripts.dev:fps: bun run bundle:renderer && bun run --filter=photosphere dev:fps
scripts.build: bun run bundle:renderer && bun run --filter=photosphere build
scripts.bundle: bun run bundle:main && bun run bundle:renderer
scripts.smoke: bun run test:cli && bun run test:electron
scripts.test:electron: cd ./apps/desktop/ && bash ./smoke-tests.sh && cd ../.. && what-changed baseline capture test:electron
scripts.test:cli: cd ./apps/cli && bash ./smoke-tests.sh && cd ../.. && what-changed baseline capture test:cli
scripts.test:cli:encrypted: cd ./apps/cli/ && bash ./smoke-tests-encrypted.sh && cd ../.. && what-changed baseline capture test:cli:encrypted
scripts.test:cli:lan-share: cd ./apps/cli/ && bash ./smoke-tests-lan-share.sh && cd ../.. && what-changed baseline capture test:cli:lan-share
scripts.test:cli:hash-cache: cd ./apps/cli/ && bash ./hash-cache-smoke-test.sh && cd ../.. && what-changed baseline capture test:cli:hash-cache
scripts.test:cli:sync: cd ./apps/cli/ && bash ./sync-smoke-test.sh && cd ../.. && what-changed baseline capture test:cli:sync
scripts.test:cli:write-lock: cd ./apps/cli/ && bash ./write-lock-smoke-test.sh && cd ../.. && what-changed baseline capture test:cli:write-lock
scripts.test:harness: cd ./apps/smoke-tests && bash ./android-lock.test.sh && bash ./runner.test.sh && bash ./timeout.test.sh && cd ../.. && what-changed baseline capture test:harness
scripts.test:and: cd ./apps/smoke-tests && PLATFORM=android bash ./run.sh && cd ../.. && what-changed baseline capture test:and
scripts.test:ios: cd ./apps/smoke-tests && PLATFORM=ios bash ./run.sh && cd ../.. && what-changed baseline capture test:ios
scripts.test:and:unit: bun run --filter=android-frontend test:unit && what-changed baseline capture test:and:unit
scripts.test:ios:unit: bun run --filter=ios-frontend test:unit && what-changed baseline capture test:ios:unit
scripts.build:ios: bun --filter=ios-frontend sync && cd ./apps/ios-frontend/ios/App && xcodebuild -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme App -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' build
